name: CETCO
description: Environmental-materials business of Minerals Technologies: organically modified bentonite (ORGANOCLAY) that adsorbs oils and high-molecular-weight organics from water, plus GCL liners and PFAS adsorbents. Sold into industrial wastewater and groundwater remediation.
notes: CETCO is a Minerals Technologies business segment; cetco.com redirects to mineralstech.com. ORGANOCLAY is still sold, but no current page positions it for produced water (the Environmental Products page is now liners, mining, CCR and vapour mitigation) — the produced-water attribution rests on the card's source.
